description.en: Adds a search button to the conversation header and shows the matches in the right sidebar: it searches the whole session history through the host log rather than only the messages already loaded, highlights every keyword in both user messages and replies, and jumps the conversation to a chosen hit. It keeps working when the full-text index is disabled.
description.zh: 在对话头部加一个搜索按钮，命中结果展示在右侧栏：检索走宿主日志，能搜整段会话历史而不只是已加载的消息，命中关键词在用户消息与 AI 回复里都标黄，点结果可跳转到对话中的位置；全文索引被关闭时同样可用。
